question: What does the word “synergy” mean as used in the passage?

options.text: Cooperation that leads to a greater effect

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. cooperation that leads to a greater effect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"synergy"** means:

 
 
• The interaction or cooperation of two or more organizations, substances, or other agents to produce a combined effect greater than the sum of their separate effects. (सहयोग जिससे अधिक प्रभाव होता है)
 
 
 
• The correct meaning of "synergy" in the given context is **"cooperation that leads to a greater effect."**
 
• **Example from the passage:** The synergy between the two departments resulted in an innovative product.
 
 
• **Example:** By working together, the teams created a synergy that greatly enhanced their productivity.
 
 

Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of “synergy” is: **cooperation that leads to a greater effect.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conflict** (संघर्ष): A serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

 
 
• **Example:** There was a conflict of interest between the two parties.
 
 
 
• **Separation** (अलगाव): The action or state of moving or being moved apart.
 
 
• **Example:** The separation of the two companies was finalized last year.
 
 
 
• **Competition** (प्रतिस्पर्धा): The activity or condition of competing.
 
 
• **Example:** There is fierce competition in the tech industry.
